title: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 9.3 Use Properties of Angles, Triangles, and the Pythagorean Theorem: Use the properties of angles
summary: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 9.3 Use Properties of Angles, Triangles, and the Pythagorean Theorem: Use the properties of angles
body: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, section "9.3 Use Properties of Angles, Triangles, and the Pythagorean Theorem", prints these objectives: "Use the properties of angles" "Use the properties of triangles" "Use the Pythagorean Theorem". The section text says: "So far in this chapter, we have focused on solving word problems, which are similar to many real-world applications of algebra. In the next few sections, we will apply our problem-solving strategies to some common geometry problems." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
